867.speaker: Player_Romus
867.text: "Do you doubt my ability to handle this? I've already deployed forces against the protesters. I will deploy more if I have to."

868.speaker: Titus Gordion
868.text: "It is my job and my life's calling to stay abreast of threats to your life, Your Majesty. At the moment, there don't seem to be any."

869.speaker: Titus Gordion
869.text: "It will be the occasion of the year, I'm sure."

871.speaker: Player_Romus
871.text: "My mother's birthday is the perfect opportunity to strike. Those who don't respect their King are in for a hostile takeover."

872.speaker: Player_Romus
872.text: "I'll speak with them. Let them know the Crown is not to be messed with."

873.speaker: Player_Romus
873.text: "I must pass decrees aimed at centralizing my power. They can't usurp me if they have no armies of their own."

874.speaker: Player_Romus
874.text: “What do you think I should do?"

878.speaker: Titus Gordion
878.text: "I worry that open rivalry amongst the Houses during a time of national destabilization will only tear Rizia apart further."

879.speaker: Titus Gordion
879.text: "But if you truly want to ensure that certain families will no longer be a problem..."

880.speaker: Player_Romus
880.text: "I don't have time for history lessons. Get to the point."

881.speaker: Titus Gordion
881.text: "The point is that with the aid of the Golden Guard, the King forced this would-be Count to sign over his wealth, title and power. In full view of all the other nobles of Rizia."

883.speaker: Titus Gordion
883.text: "If that's all, I will take my leave."

884.speaker: Narrator
884.text: Titus awaited my response with curiosity.

885.speaker: Player_Romus
885.text: "Has the Golden Guard ever been employed in an exotic dancing capacity?"

886.speaker: Player_Romus
886.text: "Remember Sal's mandragora? What if we spike the wine with it?"

890.speaker: Player_Romus
890.text: "You see all these taxidermied animals in here? We could seat them around the table, as if they were guests. It would be ever so whimsical."

895.speaker: Titus Gordion
895.text: "This one will have a beautiful backdrop, at least."

901.speaker: Titus Gordion
901.text: "I'm a Wruhec's Guardian, Your Majesty. Such an act would be beyond sinful."

902.speaker: Titus Gordion
902.text: "You don't want to see that, Your Majesty. Trust me."

903.speaker: Player_Romus
903.text: "Wouldn't it be a riot if we were to strike down one of the other noble houses?"

904.speaker: Player_Romus
904.text: "You're my most trusted guardsman. What do you think I should do?"

905.speaker: Titus Gordion
905.text: "We'll also be on the lookout for any threats from the other nobles, of course."

906.speaker: Titus Gordion
906.text: "If that's all, then I will take my leave."

911.speaker: Player_Romus
911.text: "Why did you say some of the nobles might hesitate? What do you know that I don't?"

912.speaker: Player_Romus
912.text: "If that's all, then you may go."

913.speaker: Player_Romus
913.text: "My gut feeling is that my noble rivals pose a bigger threat to myself and this kingdom than the revolutionaries. Something must be done about them."

916.speaker: Player_Romus
916.text: "The gathering is still some time away. If the unrest hasn't abated by then, I will have the necessary conversations."

917.speaker: Player_Romus
917.text: "How do you know I'm in good standing with them?"

918.speaker: Titus Gordion
918.text: "I'm guarding your life, Your Majesty. It's my business to know if anyone means you harm -- even your own family members."

920.speaker: Player_Romus
920.text: "I will not tolerate disloyalty from within my own court. My mother's birthday is the perfect time to strike."

921.speaker: Narrator
921.text: Titus widened his eyes in surprise.

924.speaker: Player_Romus
924.text: "You heard me. Those who don't respect their King are in for a hostile takeover."

925.speaker: Player_Romus
925.text: "Strike an intimidating pose, I mean. When I speak with the other Houses, I will let them know that the Crown is not to be messed with."

926.speaker: Player_Romus
926.text: "Indeed. It is time to put my rivals in their place."

930.speaker: Player_Romus
930.text: "Just joking, of course. This will be a peaceful gathering, or my mother will kill me."

934.speaker: Player_Romus
934.text: "I'm worried about rivals within my court. Revolution or not, the time has come to strike back at them."

938.speaker: Player_Romus
938.text: "Those who would try to interfere with my Wruhecist vision for Rizia."

939.speaker: Player_Romus
939.text: "The reform movement. It's grown far too strong."

943.speaker: Titus Gordion
943.text: "The protests are a worry, but they've mostly been peaceful so far."

944.speaker: Player_Romus
944.text: "I don't know. Damn, I sound just like my father."

946.speaker: Titus Gordion
946.text: "If that's all, I'll take my leave."

947.speaker: Titus Gordion
947.text: "Nobody would dare, Your Majesty. Our holy kingdom cannot be stopped."

952.speaker: Titus Gordion
952.text: "But I don't anticipate any. My hope is for an uneventful gathering."

953.speaker: Titus Gordion
953.text: "I have reason to believe some among them cannot be trusted."

955.speaker: Player_Romus
955.text: "Nonsense. The royal houses all love me."

957.speaker: Player_Romus
957.text: "Of course they can't be trusted. But what else is new?"

958.speaker: Titus Gordion
958.text: "You know best, Your Majesty. But I have to say..."

959.speaker: Player_Romus
959.text: "Thank you, Captain. We’ll need to evaluate these findings carefully and consider our next steps.”

960.speaker: Player_Romus
960.text: “It’s clear that we need a more nuanced strategy to handle the noble houses."

961.speaker: Player_Romus
961.text: "Nobles... can't live with them, can't live without them."

965.speaker: Narrator
965.text: Titus' tone seemed to indicate that he had other ideas in mind.

966.speaker: Titus Gordion
966.text: "I don't have reason to believe anyone is plotting against the Crown -- yet. But you should exercise caution."

967.speaker: Player_Romus
967.text: "These are exactly the kind of issues I didn't want to deal with right now. We need to employ *decisive* measures to deal with them."

968.speaker: Player_Romus
968.text: "We'll continue keeping a close eye on them. No need to rush into anything just yet."

969.speaker: Player_Romus
969.text: "I can no longer have these Houses roam free. We need to employ *decisive* measures to deal with them."

970.speaker: Titus Gordion
970.text: "That's all the knowledge I have. It's up to you to decide what to do with it."

976.speaker: Player_Romus
976.text: "Are you sure? I'm the King, after all. *Somebody* must want me dead."

977.speaker: Titus Gordion
977.text: "Many people do. But none of them are on the guest list."

996.speaker: Titus Gordion
996.text: "Just to be clear, Your Majesty, which of the Houses are you speaking of?"

997.speaker: Narrator
997.text: He took a moment to process what I'd said.

998.speaker: Player_Romus
998.text: "What would you do if you were in my place, Titus?"

1002.speaker: Player_Romus
1002.text: "Yes. At my mother's birthday, I shall put them in their place. Forcefully, if need be. But I can't do it without your help."

1003.speaker: Player_Romus
1003.text: "When they show up at Mother's birthday, I'll give them a stern talking-to."

1005.speaker: Titus Gordion
1005.text: "That's wise, Your Majesty. I do believe the unrest merits more of our attention."

1009.speaker: Titus Gordion
1009.text: "That's wise, Your Majesty. Perhaps there's still time to solve any differences diplomatically."

1011.speaker: Titus Gordion
1011.text: "You would move against House Toras? Your flesh and blood?"

1012.speaker: Titus Gordion
1012.text: "They've always treated me with respect and dignity, and I have a great deal of respect for them."

1014.speaker: Player_Romus
1014.text: "You have your orders, Captain. Don't question me."

1016.speaker: Narrator
1016.text: Titus’s lips pressed into a thin line, though he offered no protest.

1021.speaker: Titus Gordion
1021.text: "I admit I never cared for Ricardus. But the others have always treated me with respect and dignity."

1022.speaker: Titus Gordion
1022.text: "Besides which... history does not look kindly on kings who go after their own kin."

1023.speaker: Player_Romus
1023.text: "All I want is to force their compliance with the Crown. If we do this right, no blood need be shed."

1024.speaker: Narrator
1024.text: Titus' lips pressed into a thin line. Finally, he nodded.

1025.speaker: Player_Romus
1025.text: "Perhaps you're right. Let's leave House Toras out of the equation, then."

1029.speaker: Player_Romus
1029.text: "Perhaps you're right. My extended family and I should work out our problems through dialogue, not violence."

1030.speaker: Player_Romus
1030.text: "I'm well aware of their nefarious activities."

1034.speaker: Player_Romus
1034.text: "Oh, I know all about their nefarious activities, but watching them try is half the fun."

1035.speaker: Narrator
1035.text: The corner of Titus' mouth twitched upwards.

1036.speaker: Titus Gordion
1036.text: “If I may ask, how are you planning on handling the situation?"

1041.speaker: Player_Romus
1041.text: "I'll pass decrees aimed at centralizing my power. They cannot usurp me if they have no armies."

1047.speaker: Titus Gordion
1047.text: "That's wise, Your Majesty. Bringing the dissenting nobles around to your side will help you tackle the real threats to Rizia."

1055.speaker: Player_Romus
1055.text: "You're my head of security. What do you think I should do?"

1057.speaker: Titus Gordion
1057.text: "Are you sure such a situation doesn't call for more decisive measures?"

1063.speaker: Titus Gordion
1063.text: "Forgive me, Your Majesty, but are you sure?"

1068.speaker: Titus Gordion
1068.text: "I must say, I doubt the Sazons could unseat you even if they wanted to. The family is still too fractured."

1069.speaker: Titus Gordion
1069.text: "It's true House Sazon has grown stronger now that their matriarch Angelica has been rehabilitated."

1081.speaker: Player_Romus
1081.text: "This is purely a defensive measure. If I don't do anything, Hugo and the others will come for me first."

1086.speaker: Titus Gordion
1086.text: "I don't have any indication that the Sazons wish you harm. An unjust attack on them could turn others against you."

1093.speaker: Titus Gordion
1093.text: "As for the other House in question..."
1093.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false)

1094.speaker: Titus Gordion
1094.text: "A family as powerful as the Azaros is not to be trifled with. We must think carefully before directly challenging them."

1098.speaker: Titus Gordion
1098.text: "I understand your concerns about the Azaros' power, but the family has only exercised it in loyalty to the Crown so far."

1099.speaker: Player_Romus
1099.text: "I don't care. House Sazon has had this coming since the 1926 uprising."

1107.speaker: Player_Romus
1107.text: "This is a preemptive measure. We've got to strike while their defenses are down."

1108.speaker: Player_Romus
1108.text: "Your concerns are valid. Let's just aim for House Toras, then."
1108.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false)

1112.speaker: Player_Romus
1112.text: "Your concerns are valid. All right, let's abandon this train of thought. My mother's birthday will go precisely as planned."
1112.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false)

1113.speaker: Titus Gordion
1113.text: "If that's everything, then I'll take my leave."

1118.speaker: Player_Romus
1118.text: "I want the Azaros gone. But perhaps you're right about House Sazon. We will leave them alone."
1118.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false)

1119.speaker: Player_Romus
1119.text: "You heard me. Both House Sazon and House Azaro must be wiped off the map."
1119.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false)

1120.speaker: Player_Romus
1120.text: "I trust your judgement. Let's stick to House Toras as the sole target."
1120.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false)

1124.speaker: Player_Romus
1124.text: "Alright... Nobody will be targeted. The birthday will go as planned."
1124.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false)

1125.speaker: Titus Gordion
1125.text: "I appreciate your trust in me. And I do think any differences with the other nobles can be solved diplomatically."

1128.speaker: Player_Romus
1128.text: "All right. If you think it's wise, we will target House Sazon only."
1128.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false)

1137.speaker: Titus Gordion
1137.text: "I would focus my efforts on keeping order in the realm. At this time, encouraging unity among the Houses seems more prudent than stoking discord."

1138.speaker: Player_Romus
1138.text: "Thank you. I shall take your advice."

1139.speaker: Player_Romus
1139.text: "I'm sorry, but I disagree. The time has come to strike."

1140.speaker: Player_Romus
1140.text: "Don't worry, I'm not planning anything rash. But I do want to give certain members of the nobility a stern talking-to."

1142.speaker: Titus Gordion
1142.text: "If you wanted to... you could use your mother's birthday as an occasion to remind the nobles in question where Rizia's true power lies."

1145.speaker: Titus Gordion
1145.text: "If that's everything, I shall take my leave."

1148.speaker: Player_Romus
1148.text: "And if I believed that keeping the Royal Houses in line was integral to keeping order in the realm?"

1152.speaker: Titus Gordion
1152.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. There may yet be time to solve this diplomatically."

1153.speaker: Player_Romus
1153.text: "That depends. What do you mean by decisive?"

1162.speaker: Titus Gordion
1162.text: "Though it won't get to the core of the nobles' resentment against you."

1166.speaker: Titus Gordion
1166.text: "It's more difficult to go against a royal house than a wayward merchant. But the Golden Guard can handle it."

1167.speaker: Player_Romus
1167.text: “But such an unfolding of events in front of the other Houses could provoke unrest and undermine our position.”

1168.speaker: Titus Gordion
1168.text: “On the contrary, Your Majesty. Such a decisive action would serve as a stark warning to all Houses.”

1169.speaker: Titus Gordion
1169.text: “It would ensure they remain in their place and think twice before plotting against you.”

1170.speaker: Titus Gordion
1170.text: “And just as important, it would demonstrate that dissent against the King is met with swift and uncompromising action.”

1171.speaker: Player_Romus
1171.text: "By the sound of it, it seems you've had such a contingency plan in place for quite some time."

1172.speaker: Titus Gordion
1172.text: "Your Majesty, when I say the Guard is prepared for any contingencies, I mean *every* possibility."

1173.speaker: Titus Gordion
1173.text: "Such a decisive action would serve as a stark warning to all Houses.”

1174.speaker: Player_Romus
1174.text: "If it ensures the safety of the Crown, I am prepared to take such measures."

1176.speaker: Player_Romus
1176.text: “How would you carry this out, exactly?"

1177.speaker: Player_Romus
1177.text: "This plan seems risky. Are we prepared for the potential fallout?"

1178.speaker: Player_Romus
1178.text: "I like the way you think, Captain."

1180.speaker: Titus Gordion
1180.text: “At some point in the course of the birthday gathering, you'd corral your targets into a room with only one exit. This one, for instance."
1180.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.TitusTalk_LucitaWarns"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.TitusTalk_LucitaWarns"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.TitusTalk_HugoWarns"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.TitusTalk_HugoWarns"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Birthday_WarnedAboutCoup"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Birthday_WarnedAboutCoup"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.TalkWithTitus_MentionedLuca"] == true)

1181.speaker: Titus Gordion
1181.text: "We could then declare our control over the House’s assets and force them to sign over their lands on the spot.”

1182.speaker: Titus Gordion
1182.text: “On your command, I and my men would overwhelm the other nobles with a decisive show of force.”

1183.speaker: Player_Romus
1183.text: "We can't afford the possibility of failure. I want this plan scrapped."

1184.speaker: Titus Gordion
1184.text: "We will prepare as thoroughly as possible, but in operations of this scale, nothing is ever 100% certain."

1185.speaker: Player_Romus
1185.text: "Okay, so let's say I agree to this plan. How would we carry it out?"

1186.speaker: Player_Romus
1186.text: "If there are so many unknowns, I have serious reservations. But please continue."

1200.speaker: Player_Romus
1200.text: "I will not have my reign remembered for such brutality."

1201.speaker: Titus Gordion
1201.text: “With all due respect, Your Majesty, if those opposing you prevail, you may not have much of a reign to be remembered.”

1202.speaker: Player_Romus
1202.text: "I still believe there are less extreme measures to address our challenges."

1206.speaker: Titus Gordion
1206.text: “If we execute this plan efficiently enough, it need not be brutal."

1207.speaker: Player_Romus
1207.text: "Okay. I'll bite. How would you propose such a plan be carried out?"

1209.speaker: Player_Romus
1209.text: "No... I'm not convinced. I want the birthday gathering to go as planned."

1210.speaker: Player_Romus
1210.text: "The situation isn't as dire as it seems. We can manage this with careful negotiation and avoid rash decisions.”

1212.speaker: Player_Romus
1212.text: "Letting events unfold naturally is the wiser course of action. These situations usually resolve themselves."

1213.speaker: Titus Gordion
1213.text: "In any case, if there's nothing else you need from me, I'll take my leave."

1214.speaker: Titus Gordion
1214.text: "Then I apologize if I've overstepped. I will speak of it no more."

1220.speaker: Player_Romus
1220.text: "It sounds like a good plan. But I don't think you should be the one to execute it. I don't want you putting your life on the line."

1221.speaker: Player_Romus
1221.text: "It seems to me that the Golden Guard would be best suited at pulling off such an operation."

1225.speaker: Player_Romus
1225.text: "It seems to me that Wruhec's Guardians would be best suited at pulling off such an operation."

1226.speaker: Titus Gordion
1226.text: "You can count on us to get the job done."

1228.speaker: Titus Gordion
1228.text: "Then they would be openly defying an order from the Crown, and therefore subject to punishment at the King's discretion."

1229.speaker: Player_Romus
1229.text: "When you frame it like that, I can't help but feel increasingly uneasy about whether this is the right approach."

1231.speaker: Player_Romus
1231.text: "Oh, is that all? For a minute, I thought we were dealing with something truly catastrophic."

1235.speaker: Player_Romus
1235.text: "I'm aware, Titus. Let's implement this plan."

1236.speaker: Player_Romus
1236.text: "And if they don't comply, we shoot them."

1237.speaker: Titus Gordion
1237.text: "If they dared to defy the Crown in such a way, they would be subject to punishment at your discretion."

1239.speaker: Titus Gordion
1239.text: "Once the signing is complete, you'd bring the nobles back into the library building with the announcement that the targeted House's lands are now under the control of the central authority, and their titles have been stripped.”

1243.speaker: Titus Gordion
1243.text: "This would be a very delicate operation. But if you believe other forces than mine are capable of carrying it out, I won't discourage you from contracting them."
1243.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_PalantorPMCAvailable"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == false)  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == false)

1244.speaker: Titus Gordion
1244.text: "This would be a very delicate operation. I wouldn't trust anyone else to carry it out."

1248.speaker: Player_Romus
1248.text: "Sevrio and the Wruhec's Guardians could take the lead."

1249.speaker: Player_Romus
1249.text: "There's always Rusty Montoro and his mercenaries from Palantor."

1256.speaker: Player_Romus
1256.text: "I trust Lucita with my life. And I've already worked with her special forces to preempt security threats in the past."

1257.speaker: Titus Gordion
1257.text: "Besides, putting my life on the line for the Crown is my job."

1258.speaker: Player_Romus
1258.text: "Come to think of it... nobody's more capable than you."

1264.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1264.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == false) == false

1265.speaker: Narrator
1265.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.TitusTalk_LucitaWarns"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.TitusTalk_LucitaWarns"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.TitusTalk_HugoWarns"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.TitusTalk_HugoWarns"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Birthday_WarnedAboutCoup"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Birthday_WarnedAboutCoup"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == false)

1266.speaker: Titus Gordion
1266.text: "Before we go any further, Your Majesty... which House do you wish to remove from power?"

1271.speaker: Player_Romus
1271.text: "No further questions. I want House Azaro wiped off the map."
1271.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false)

1272.speaker: Player_Romus
1272.text: "Trust me, Titus. If I don't deal with House Azaro now, they're going to come for me."
1272.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false)

1277.speaker: Titus Gordion
1277.text: "They handled the Sotelato situation well. But another attack by them so soon after the assassination?"

1278.speaker: Titus Gordion
1278.text: "I have my reservations about those men. But if you're certain they can be trusted..."

1280.speaker: Titus Gordion
1280.text: "A fine compromise. I could still oversee operations while Sevrio does the work on the ground."

1284.speaker: Titus Gordion
1284.text: "If you're certain Duchess Azaro is trustworthy, having military assistance could lend more legitimacy to the operation."

1285.speaker: Player_Romus
1285.text: "I'm worried they'll get suspicious beforehand. What if they figure out what we're up to?"

1289.speaker: Player_Romus
1289.text: "I can't risk a strike against the nobility while we're at war. The destabilization could be disastrous.”

1293.speaker: Player_Romus
1293.text: "The revolutionaries are the real problem. I'll have to handle the nobles later."

1294.speaker: Player_Romus
1294.text: "If uncertainty is our only guarantee, then perhaps I should start practicing my ‘We Tried Our Best’ speech."

1298.speaker: Titus Gordion
1298.text: "I'd suggest we prepare for the ‘Unstoppable Victory’ speech, as I'm confident we'll achieve just that."

1299.speaker: Titus Gordion
1299.text: "You can count on my guards' discretion."

1300.speaker: Titus Gordion
1300.text: "Or bring in a third party, one with more distance from the Crown."
1300.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_PalantorPMCAvailable"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == false)

1302.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1302.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_PalantorPMCAvailable"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == false)

1303.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1303.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_PalantorPMCAvailable"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == false)) == false

1304.speaker: Player_Romus
1304.text: "I don't know... I'm worried that the repercussions from such an operation could be too great a risk."

1305.speaker: Player_Romus
1305.text: "Yes. I can't thank you enough for suggesting it to me."

1306.speaker: Player_Romus
1306.text: "We must do what must be done. We shall prepare to strike at the birthday gathering."

1307.speaker: Titus Gordion
1307.text: "But we're getting ahead of ourselves. Your Majesty, is this really the course of action you want to pursue?"
1307.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rusty_PalantorPMCAvailable"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] > 0  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == false)) == false

1308.speaker: Titus Gordion
1308.text: "You're right that while the reward would be significant, we will need to prepare for potential setbacks."

1309.speaker: Titus Gordion
1309.text: "Your mother and anyone else you wanted to keep safe would remain in the main atrium, insulated from harm."

1310.speaker: Titus Gordion
1310.text: "We're talking about a drastic measure. One that could spark fear and animosity within Rizia as well as abroad."

1314.speaker: Titus Gordion
1314.text: "I have doubts myself, in light of the national unrest."

1318.speaker: Titus Gordion
1318.text: "I also have my doubts that such an extreme retaliation is warranted."
1318.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] < 0) == false)

1319.speaker: Titus Gordion
1319.text: "But if these rumors about insubordination are true, a strong reprimand may well be needed to preserve order among the houses."

1320.speaker: Titus Gordion
1320.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] < 0)

1324.speaker: Titus Gordion
1324.text: "But it's rare that the heads of all three royal houses are gathered in the same place at the same time. If you do want to organize this strike, now is the opportunity."

1329.speaker: Titus Gordion
1329.text: "If the rumors about insubordination are true, this kind of strong reprimand may be exactly what's needed to preserve order among the houses."

1333.speaker: Titus Gordion
1333.text: "It's rare that the heads of all three royal houses are gathered in the same place at the same time. I understand you not wanting to waste this opportunity."

1344.speaker: Titus Gordion
1344.text: "So... you're saying you want to go through with it?"

1345.speaker: Player_Romus
1345.text: "You're right. The time has come. Begin the preparations."

1346.speaker: Player_Romus
1346.text: "Yes, the time has come. Begin the preparations."

1347.speaker: Player_Romus
1347.text: "I have too many misgivings to go through with this. I’m more convinced than ever that any potential conflicts can be resolved through diplomacy."

1348.speaker: Player_Romus
1348.text: "Actually, I'm having second thoughts. I would rather resolve this through diplomacy than a show of force."

1352.speaker: Player_Romus
1352.text: "No... I have more subtle means to strip the Houses of their power. I don't need to make an example of them."

1353.speaker: Titus Gordion
1353.text: "Then we shall speak of it no more."

1354.speaker: Titus Gordion
1354.text: "Well, that's all I had. If there's nothing else you need from me, I'll take my leave."

1356.speaker: Player_Romus
1356.text: "I trust you and the Golden Guard to take care of it, of course."

1357.speaker: Player_Romus
1357.text: "Rusty's men in Palantor Security Solutions will be given the contract. Call this private line to take care of it."

1368.speaker: Player_Romus
1368.text: "I'll work with Lucita and her military contacts on this. Let's leave it to the professionals."

1369.speaker: Titus Gordion
1369.text: "Very good, sir. I have no doubt Duchess Azaro will be up to the task."

1370.speaker: Player_Romus
1370.text: "I have full faith in the abilities of Sevrio and Wruhec's Guardians."

1377.speaker: Titus Gordion
1377.text: "And just to be sure, whom do you wish to task with carrying out the operation?"

1381.speaker: Player_Romus
1381.text: "I trust you, Sevrio and Wruhec's Guardians to take care of it, of course."

1386.speaker: Titus Gordion
1386.text: "I'll speak to Captain Castellanus right away."

1388.speaker: Narrator
1388.text: He shook his head in amazement.

1390.speaker: Player_Romus
1390.text: "I wish it had never come to this."

1392.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1392.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

1393.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1393.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

1394.speaker: Titus Gordion
1394.text: "Besides which... are you truly considering betraying your own wife?"
1394.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

1398.speaker: Player_Romus
1398.text: "Lucita never really loved me. She's been using me to get her family close to the throne."
1398.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true)

1402.speaker: Titus Gordion
1402.text: "And surely Her Highness won't react well to you targeting her husband."

1406.speaker: Titus Gordion
1406.text: "But Her Highness surely won't react well to you targeting her husband."

1411.speaker: Player_Romus
1411.text: "Manus has been using Vina this entire time. She'll understand someday."
1411.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)

1415.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1415.text: "You're my husband and my King. I couldn't bear it if anything happened to you."

1419.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1419.text: "Together with some suspicious provincial army movements we've tracked, I believe there is real reason for concern here."

1420.speaker: Hugo Toras
1420.text: “Rico's men have intercepted bits and pieces of correspondence referring to a 'political shift.”

1421.speaker: Hugo Toras
1421.text: "The specifics are hard to determine. So until we receive clarification, we're left with little choice but to speculate on their true intention."

1425.speaker: Hugo Toras
1425.text: "Together with some suspicious provincial army movements we've tracked, I believe there is real reason for concern here."

1430.speaker: Hugo Toras
1430.text: "Don't underestimate the reach of Su Omina. They have eyes and ears everywhere."

1431.speaker: Hugo Toras
1431.text: "But I trust you to make the right call."

1438.speaker: Titus Gordion
1438.text: "I must say, I have serious reservations about the attendance of House Sazon and House Azaro."
1438.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true) == false)

1439.speaker: Titus Gordion
1439.text: "My guards have received anonymous tips indicating growing discontent within the family."

1443.speaker: Titus Gordion
1443.text: "I must say, I have serious reservations about the attendance of House Sazon."
1443.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true) == false)

1444.speaker: Titus Gordion
1444.text: "I must say, I have serious reservations about the attendance of House Sazon -- as well as certain Torases."
1444.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true)

1445.speaker: Titus Gordion
1445.text: "My guards have received anonymous tips indicating growing discontent among both families."

1446.speaker: Player_Romus
1446.text: "Yes, and? This should hardly come as shocking news."

1447.speaker: Titus Gordion
1447.text: "My sources hint at more than run-of-the-mill complaints. They may be planning something."

1448.speaker: Player_Romus
1448.text: "Well, it seems trust is becoming a rare commodity these days. What else can you tell me?"

1449.speaker: Titus Gordion
1449.text: "From what I've been able to gather, a plot against the Crown may be in the works."

1450.speaker: Titus Gordion
1450.text: "I can't be 100 percent certain. All I know is that a treasonous plot may be in the works."

1451.speaker: Player_Romus
1451.text: "I won't tolerate betrayal -- especially from my fellow nobles. Who specifically?"

1453.speaker: Player_Romus
1453.text: "When our holy plans come to fruition, that discontent will be a distant memory."

1454.speaker: Titus Gordion
1454.text: "You may not stay in power for long enough to see that happen."

1455.speaker: Titus Gordion
1455.text: "I wouldn't have come to you if I didn't believe the evidence was credible."

1457.speaker: Titus Gordion
1457.text: "My guards have received anonymous tips indicating growing discontent within the family."

1462.speaker: Titus Gordion
1462.text: "Now *that* would be a night for the history books."

1465.speaker: Titus Gordion
1465.text: “We've intercepted bits and pieces of correspondence referring to a 'political shift.”

1466.speaker: Titus Gordion
1466.text: "The specifics are hard to determine. So until we receive clarification, we're left with little choice but to speculate on their true intention."

1470.speaker: Titus Gordion
1470.text: "Together with some suspicious provincial army movements we've tracked, I believe there is real reason for concern here."

1476.speaker: Titus Gordion
1476.text: "The Queen Mother is 75. I hardly think a festiburu is appropriate."

1477.speaker: Narrator
1477.text: A festiburu was a traditional Rizian festive object filled with treats. Participants took turns striking it until it burst.

1479.speaker: Titus Gordion
1479.text: "Anyway, the portrait's a done deal. Your thoughts?"

1480.speaker: Titus Gordion
1480.text: "I hope the archivist didn't get lost -- take a wrong turn, end up in the palace."

1482.speaker: Player_Romus
1482.text: "Why would he end up in the palace?"

1484.speaker: Titus Gordion
1484.text: "However, its true purpose is serving as an emergency escape from the royal residence."

1485.speaker: Player_Romus
1485.text: "Good to know. Might come in handy someday."

1486.speaker: Player_Romus
1486.text: "Of course I knew. I was just testing you."

1487.speaker: Player_Romus
1487.text: "A secret passageway? And no one thought it necessary to tell me about it?

1488.speaker: Player_Romus
1488.text: "Well, if the archivist doesn't return, I suppose we’ll have our answer."

1490.speaker: Titus Gordion
1490.text: "You don’t know? There’s a hidden passageway beneath the archives -- once used to discreetly transport books to and from the library."

1491.speaker: Titus Gordion
1491.text: "My apologies, Your Majesty. I thought you knew"

1494.speaker: Titus Gordion
1494.text: "We’ll send a search party -- perhaps some hounds to track him down."

1498.speaker: Titus Gordion
1498.text: "I must say, I have serious reservations about the attendance of House Azaro -- as well as certain members of House Toras."
1498.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true)

1503.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1503.text: "Of course I'd never advise you to do anything rash without concrete proof. But I'll remind you that you have my armies at your disposal."

1507.speaker: Titus Gordion
1507.text: "The painter has reported that the commissioned piece is complete and will be delivered to you shortly."

1511.speaker: Titus Gordion
1511.text: "Especially after you entrusted Wruhec's Guardians and myself with protecting the kingdom and your own safety."
